record.original_question: Let C be a smooth projective curve of gonality k and genus g. Say that C satisfies the linear growth condition when dim W^1_{k+n}(C) ≤ n for every integer n with 0 ≤ n ≤ g - 2k + 2. Under this definition, study Conjecture (9.1): a smooth projective curve C of gonality k and genus g satisfies the linear growth condition as soon as dim W^1_k(C) = 0.

evidence.quote: (9.1) Conjecture. A smooth projective curve C of gonality k and genus g satisfies the linear growth condition as soon as dim W1 k (C) = 0.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C$ be a smooth projective curve over the complex numbers of genus $g$ and gonality $k$, i.e., $k$ is the minimal degree of a non-constant morphism $C \to \mathbb{P}^1$. For an integer $d \geq 0$, let
$$W^1_d(C) = \{\, L \in \mathrm{Pic}^d(C) : h^0(C,L) \geq 2 \,\}$$
denote the Brill–Noether locus parametrizing line bundles of degree $d$ on $C$ admitting at least a pencil of sections.

Say that $C$ satisfies the linear growth condition if
$$\dim W^1_{k+n}(C) \leq n \quad \text{for every integer } n \text{ with } 0 \leq n \leq g - 2k + 2.$$

Prove or disprove: every smooth projective curve $C$ of gonality $k$ and genus $g$ such that $\dim W^1_k(C) = 0$ satisfies the linear growth condition.
artifact.status_search_result: The linear growth condition was introduced by Aprodu in connection with Green's conjecture, and the implication "dim W^1_k(C) = 0 ⇒ linear growth" is a conjectural strengthening used to deduce Green's conjecture in several settings (e.g., curves on K3 surfaces, general k-gonal curves). Available literature continues to refer to it as a conjecture and uses it as a hypothesis rather than a theorem in general; no general proof was located.

status_evidence.title: Green's Conjecture for General Covers (Aprodu–Farkas)
status_evidence.snippet: Aprodu's Theorem: Green's conjecture holds for any k-gonal curve C of genus g provided it satisfies the linear growth condition.
status_evidence.claim: The linear growth condition is used as a hypothesis to deduce Green's conjecture; deriving it from dim W^1_k(C)=0 remains a conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Linear syzygies of curves with prescribed gonality
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on syzygies of curves with prescribed gonality continues to reference Aprodu's linear growth framework.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent literature treats the linear growth statement as a conjectural input rather than an established theorem in full generality.
